title: The Future of Autonomous Systems: Unlocking the Potential of Physical AI and Edge AI
description: Physical AI is very related to Edge AI. Find out what Physical AI is and how DEEPCRAFT™ fits into this
long_description: As technology continues to advance at a rapid pace, we're witnessing the emergence of new and exciting fields that are transforming the way we interact with machines. One such area that's gaining significant attention is Physical AI, a field that focuses on creating artificial intelligence systems that can adapt to and interact with their physical environment in real-time. In this blog post, we'll delve into the world of Physical AI, its connections to Edge AI, and how Edge AI software is supporting the development of autonomous systems. To learn more click on the article below.
